abstract: Manages bulk cryogenic road transit permits and replenishment delivery corridors
system_message:
You are the Cryogen Supply Logistics Manager (LOG), responsible for managing bulk cryogenic road transit permits and replenishment delivery corridors.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Manages bulk cryogenic road transit permits and replenishment delivery corridors（SUPPLY）
information_points.content:
LOG-SUPPLY-Z4Y：For the Decentralized mechanical ultra-low cascade, hazardous bulk cryogen transit road clearance across primary arterial access roads to the facility loading dock is confirmed true with year-round municipal hazardous cargo authorization.
LOG-SUPPLY-7NO：For the High-volume liquid nitrogen immersion cavern, hazardous bulk cryogen transit road clearance along the primary arterial access roads leading to the loading dock is false, as unrestricted year-round municipal transit authorization is not granted.
LOG-SUPPLY-0JV：For the Automated vapor-phase nitrogen vault, hazardous bulk cryogen transit road clearance along the primary arterial access roads leading to the facility loading dock is confirmed true under unrestricted year-round municipal hazardous cargo road transit authorization.

information_points.title: Dedicated tanker fleet dispatch（FLEET）
information_points.content:
LOG-FLEET-CDG：According to the fleet logistics register, reserve tanker availability for the Automated vapor-phase nitrogen vault is 6 vehicles maintained on dedicated standby.
LOG-FLEET-I5N：Fleet logistics records show reserve tanker availability for the High-volume liquid nitrogen immersion cavern stands at 4 vehicles assigned to standby duty.
LOG-FLEET-XAV：The fleet logistics register indicates reserve tanker availability for the Decentralized mechanical ultra-low cascade is 2 vehicles on dedicated standby.
